visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for ordinary shared care, incoming family and herd introduction, the departure conflict, obligation shaping, the final threshold, and four success-or-cost ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the warm-hollow establishing view, participant introduction, routine care hub, routine fold, herd departure pulse, departure action hub, obligation fold, obligation hub, first-route threshold, and each ending family. visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt stands alone, explains fictional anatomy and living infrastructure in visible terms, and names only characters or groups visible in frame. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints; prompt assembly uses visible geometry in the base prompt or triggered modifier.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: painterly speculative-ecology storybook frame, restrained gouache and ink texture, readable alien anatomy, tactile root-grown civic spaces, low-energy bioluminescence, translucent heat-bearing tissue, deep eclipse blues with copper warmth and muted amber, domestic tenderness under real logistical pressure, cinematic interactive-fiction composition.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each image prompt from the global_style_cue, the scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters and groups visible in that frame, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Exclude continuity notes and absent character refs. Every text-only render receives complete visible geometry.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide elevated view of a shallow oval care hollow made of dark root-bound stone at the edge of an alien reproductive commons. A broad low nursery ramp enters at the inner end. Two waist-low arches grown from pale intertwined roots open at the outer end: the left leads onto a packed-earth glassback calving lane and the right onto a Sa'ueia family path, both edged by paired amber fungal candles and curving toward a possible join after the first bend. Curved lantern trees line both long sides, their cold blue knots hanging below the canopies. A central oval bed of dark mineral sand holds several broad low-slung grazing animals with translucent copper-glowing dorsal plates and several long-bodied six-limbed caretakers and children resting beside them. An enormous fixed dark planet begins to eclipse a dim red-orange sun.

visible_characters.default_stance: mixed Sa'ueia and glassback bodies resting around the central mineral-sand bed
